business_problem: OnticWorks.io needed its Elmer agentic platform to reason within the physical and operational context where work happens instead of relying on disconnected dashboards, emails, sensor feeds, and simulations that users still had to interpret manually.
solution_summary: OnticWorks.io integrated IBM Bob into Elmer's core reasoning loop so the platform could attach spatial context to the multimodal information it was already processing. Cameras, environmental sensors, drone systems, enterprise applications, and user interactions feed the system, while IBM Bob models the relationships between people, places, assets, and events as they unfold. IBM watsonx.ai supplies the multimodal reasoning layer and NVIDIA-powered inference runs on Red Hat OpenShift, allowing Elmer to combine voice, vision, gesture recognition, and operational telemetry before producing a recommendation. Recommendations are then routed through a draft-and-approve workflow so humans remain in control and the system learns from overrides and approvals. OnticWorks.io reused the same architecture across administrative operations, agricultural decision support, and robotics education rather than building separate products for each environment.

solution_components.name: IBM Bob
solution_components.role: Adds spatial context so Elmer can understand how people, places, assets, and events relate in real time.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx.ai
solution_components.role: Provides the multimodal reasoning capability that evaluates operational context before recommending actions.

solution_components.name: Red Hat OpenShift
solution_components.role: Hosts the Elmer platform and its inference services across digital and physical operating environments.

data_flow: Webcams, sensors, drones, enterprise applications, and user interactions feed Elmer; IBM Bob enriches those inputs with spatial relationships, IBM watsonx.ai reasons over the multimodal context on Red Hat OpenShift, and the platform returns draft recommendations that users approve, modify, or override.
business_outcome: OnticWorks.io used contextual AI to reclaim manager time, cut agricultural water use and manual monitoring, improve crop yields, accelerate its robotics education launch, and help students deploy autonomous agents from simulation to physical hardware more successfully.
